offering_description.value: Crexendo delivers cloud phone, video, messaging and contact center services to businesses. It develops and licenses communications platform software that telecom carriers and managed service providers use to offer their own hosted communications services.

primary_products.value: unified communications platform software; contact center software; IP desk phones

primary_services.value: hosted business phone service; cloud video and messaging; hosted contact center services; managed IT services

customer_segment.value: B2B: small and midsize businesses, enterprise communications teams, telecom carriers and managed service providers

end_markets.value: business communications across industries; contact center operations; telecommunications and managed IT services

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring access to hosted phone, collaboration and contact center services; licensing or royalties: rights for service providers to deploy and use communications platform software; product sales: IP phones and related customer equipment; service fees: implementation, training and managed IT services
revenue_model.category: subscription; licensing or royalties; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: combines communications software, cloud infrastructure and carrier connectivity to deliver hosted services to businesses; software / platform: develops communications software for carriers and managed service providers to run their own offerings

geography_served.value: global: hosted communications primarily in the United States, with platform software deployed internationally

specialization.value: related lines: hosted business communications, contact centers, managed IT and communications platform software

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving business accounts and telecom software buyers; partners / resellers: telecom resellers, independent channel partners and managed service providers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: interconnected VoIP subject to FCC emergency calling, number portability and universal service contribution rules

notes: The current relative size of the hosted services and platform software businesses is uncertain.
